turn1.explanation: The unit responds to close-up frontal faces of small furry mammals, especially the light-colored muzzle and nose area of cats, foxes, red pandas, ferrets and hamsters. It also responds more weakly to some reddish or warm-toned objects such as the front of a red car.
turn1.evidence: Nearly all of the top 20 photos are close-up mammal faces with the red shading centered on the snout. The weakest photos in the same classes show the animal small, far away or not facing the camera, while dark, wrinkled dog muzzles (mastiffs, pugs) and dark birds drive the unit most negative.
